description: This file defines the 'Error' class in the Twig templating engine, serving as the base exception class for template-related errors. It handles error message formatting, source context tracking, and template info guessing to aid debugging.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Base exception class for errors occurring during Twig template loading, syntax errors, or rendering. Tracks template name, line, source code, and file to facilitate debugging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Error object with message, line number, source context, and previous exception.

methods.name: getTemplateLine
methods.description: Returns the line number where the error occurred in the template.

methods.name: setTemplateLine
methods.description: Sets the line number where the error occurred and updates the error message accordingly.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns a Source object containing the source code, name, and path if available.

methods.name: setSourceContext
methods.description: Sets or clears the source context and updates internal fields.

methods.name: guess
methods.description: Attempts to automatically determine template name and line number based on the call stack.

methods.name: appendMessage
methods.description: Appends additional information to the error's message.

methods.name: updateRepr
methods.description: Updates the string representation of the error based on current properties.

methods.name: guessTemplateInfo
methods.description: Guesses the template name, path, and line number by inspecting the call stack and template objects.
